exposure: Mackey Childbirth Satisfaction Rating Scale (MCSRS) in Brazilian Portuguese
cohort: The study included 411 early postpartum women in a low-risk maternity hospital in Brazil, aged 18-34 years, who gave birth to a live infant at over 36 weeks' gestation, including those who underwent an unplanned cesarean section.
finding: Confirmatory factor analysis indicated good fitness for the model and confirmed the six subscales of the MCSRS, which also demonstrated high overall reliability (Cronbach's alpha 0.96, McDonald's omega 0.97), establishing it as a valid instrument.
mod_finding: The inclusion criteria encompassed women who underwent an unplanned cesarean section, thereby extending the utility of the MCSRS to assess satisfaction across different birth modes.
cross-section timing: Data was collected between 2017 and 2018, in the early postpartum period.
